faqs.question: What are easy anime couple costumes for beginners?
faqs.answer: Light and L from Death Note is the cheapest: about 1 hour and $15 DIY for two, using a shirt and tie, a black notebook, a baggy white long-sleeve tee and jeans. Taki and Mitsuha from Your Name and Miyamura and Hori from Horimiya are school-uniform builds of about 1.5 hours with no wig.

faqs.question: Which anime couple costumes will people who don't watch anime recognise?
faqs.answer: Sailor Moon and Tuxedo Mask, Ash and Pikachu, and Satsuki with Totoro score 5 out of 5 on our non-fan scale. Jessie and James, Naruto and Hinata, and Chihiro with No-Face score 4.

faqs.question: What anime couple costume works if one of us is much taller?
faqs.answer: Pick a pair where the height gap is the point. Taiga and Ryuji from Toradora!, Legoshi and Haru from Beastars, Edward and Alphonse from Fullmetal Alchemist, and Chihiro with No-Face all work better with a tall partner and a short one.

faqs.question: Are there anime couple costumes that work for any gender?
faqs.answer: Yes. Kiki and Jiji, Ash and Pikachu, Light and L, Gojo and Geto, and Hinata and Kageyama are all read by their props and outfits rather than by who wears them.

faqs.question: How much does an anime couple costume cost?
faqs.answer: Our estimates for two people run from $15 DIY for Light and L to $200 bought for Edward and Alphonse. Most iconic classics land between $45 DIY and $140 bought, mainly because of wigs.

faqs.question: Do we need wigs for anime couple cosplay?
faqs.answer: For 14 of the 26 pairs on our list, at least one of you does. Studio Ghibli pairs are the exception: only Sophie and Howl need wigs, so Ghibli is the best route if either of you dislikes wearing one.

faqs.question: Is it safe to wear coloured contact lenses for an anime costume?
faqs.answer: Only if an eye doctor fits them. A 2013 American Academy of Ophthalmology answer says contact lenses should be fitted only by licensed professionals and that shops selling unfitted lenses are usually breaking the law; let the wig and makeup carry the look instead.

faqs.question: What does cosplay is not consent mean?
faqs.answer: It means a costume is not permission to touch, photograph or comment on someone. Naka-Kon's etiquette page asks attendees not to touch a cosplayer, their costume or props without permission and not to take photos without asking first.

faqs.question: What are the newest anime couple costumes?
faqs.answer: From our list, Okarun and Momo from Dandadan (anime from October 2024) and Frieren and Himmel from Frieren (anime from September 2023) are the most recent. Both score 1 out of 5 for non-fans, so expect to be recognised mostly by other fans.

faqs.question: Which Studio Ghibli couple costume is easiest?
faqs.answer: Kiki and Jiji or Satsuki and Totoro: each takes about 1 hour and needs no wig. Satsuki and Totoro also scores 5 out of 5 for non-fans, thanks to the grey onesie and the black umbrella.

faqs.question: Can I send our anime couple costume photos as a Halloween card?
faqs.answer: Yes. SubhSandesh's Happy Halloween page has a partner mode that takes up to six photos, which your partner finds by wiping fog off portraits before answering "Will you be my boo?". The premium page takes up to 12 photos and a 60-second voice note.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Anime Couple Costumes: 26 Pairs Rated for Effort, Cost and Wigs

The anime couple costumes that work best at a Halloween party are the ones a stranger can name from three items: Sailor Moon and Tuxedo Mask, Ash and Pikachu, and Satsuki with Totoro score 5 out of 5 on our non-fan scale, while Frieren and Himmel score 1. Two numbers from our own platform shaped the list: 48.3% of the pages people share on SubhSandesh are opened on a phone, so we favoured outlines that still read in a small photo; and in the nearest festival we have measured, Raksha Bandhan 2026, 49.4% of pages were built on the day itself, so 12 of these 26 pairs take two hours or less. Each pair lists the year the anime started, three silhouette items, build hours, DIY-versus-buy cost for two, wig needs, and a 1–5 score for how readable it is to non-fans.

## What makes an anime couple costume readable?

An anime couple costume is a matched pair of characters from one Japanese animated series or film, worn so the two outfits explain each other. It reads when three items, usually hair, one garment and one prop, let a viewer place the character without a caption.

The photo is part of the costume. Nicolle Lamerichs of Utrecht University, in a [2015 Transformative Works and Cultures study](https://journal.transformativeworks.org/index.php/twc/article/view/606), calls cosplay "a shared, lived, and embodied space of play" that fans carry into photography and tie to their identity. A [2026 BMC Psychology systematic review](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC13289549) of nine studies of adults aged 18–60 found that anime fans who cosplay scored higher on extraversion and openness than fans who do not.

## 26 anime couple costumes, grouped by effort and era

Costs are our US-dollar estimates for two. "Read" is our score: 5 means a trick-or-treating parent names it, 1 means only fans will.

### 1. Beginner and closet cosplay (5 pairs)

- **Taki and Mitsuha**, *Your Name* (film, 2016): two school uniforms, her red braided cord, a name written on each palm. 1.5 hours; $25 DIY/$70 buy; no wig; read 1/5.
- **Miyamura and Hori**, *Horimiya* (anime, 2021): school uniforms, his clip-on ear piercings, a temporary arm tattoo. 1.5 hours; $20 DIY/$60 buy; no wig; read 1/5.
- **Kaguya and Shirogane**, *Kaguya-sama: Love Is War* (anime, 2019): black uniforms with gold trim, her red hair ribbon, his eye-bag makeup. 2 hours; $30 DIY/$90 buy; wigs optional; read 1/5.
- **Light and L**, *Death Note* (anime, 2006): his shirt and tie with a black notebook, L's baggy white long-sleeve tee, jeans and bare feet. 1 hour; $15 DIY/$50 buy; wigs optional; read 2/5.
- **Tohru and Kyo**, *Fruits Basket* (anime, 2001; remake 2019): her sailor-collar uniform and hair ribbons, his orange hair, an orange cat plush. 2 hours; $30 DIY/$80 buy; Kyo's wig yes; read 1/5.

### 2. Iconic classics (5 pairs)

- **Sailor Moon and Tuxedo Mask**, *Sailor Moon* (anime, 1992): sailor suit with red bow, blonde buns with long tails, his top hat, cape and white mask. 6 hours; $70 DIY/$130 buy; her wig yes; read 5/5.
- **Jessie and James**, *Pokémon* (anime, 1997): white uniforms with a red R, her magenta swoop of hair, his blue hair. 4 hours; $60 DIY/$130 buy; two wigs; read 4/5.
- **Bulma and Vegeta**, *Dragon Ball Z* (anime, 1989): his blue bodysuit with white gloves and chest armour, flame-shaped black hair, her teal hair. 5 hours; $70 DIY/$140 buy; two wigs; read 3/5.
- **Naruto and Hinata**, *Naruto* (anime, 2002): orange-and-black tracksuit, matching Leaf headbands, her lavender jacket. 3 hours; $45 DIY/$100 buy; his spiky blond wig; read 4/5.
- **Inuyasha and Kagome**, *Inuyasha* (anime, 2000): his red robe and white hair with dog ears, her green-and-white school uniform, a foam bow. 4 hours; $55 DIY/$120 buy; his wig yes; read 2/5.

### 3. Recent hits, 2020 to 2024 (6 pairs)

- **Loid and Yor Forger**, *Spy x Family* (anime, April 2022): his slicked side-part and dark suit, her black dress, gold rose headband and long black hair. 4 hours; $50 DIY/$120 buy; Yor's wig yes; read 2/5.
- **Marin and Gojo**, *My Dress-Up Darling* (anime, January 2022): her long blonde hair, his uniform with a tape measure round the neck. 2 hours; $35 DIY/$80 buy; Marin's wig yes; read 1/5.
- **Denji and Power**, *Chainsaw Man* (anime, October 2022), partners rather than sweethearts: matching white shirts and black ties, a cardboard chainsaw on his forehead, her red horns. 3 hours; $35 DIY/$90 buy; Power's wig yes; read 2/5.
- **Frieren and Himmel**, *Frieren* (anime, September 2023): her white twin tails and elf ears with a staff, his blue hair, white cape and sword. 6 hours; $70 DIY/$150 buy; two wigs; read 1/5.
- **Okarun and Momo**, *Dandadan* (anime, October 2024): his thick round glasses and black school uniform, her loose cardigan and socks, a toy UFO. 2 hours; $30 DIY/$70 buy; wigs optional; read 1/5.
- **Gojo and Geto**, *Jujutsu Kaisen* (anime, October 2020), a rival-partner pair: a black blindfold with white spiky hair, a dark robe with a half-bun. 3 hours; $45 DIY/$100 buy; Gojo's wig yes; read 2/5.

### 4. Studio Ghibli pairs (5 pairs)

- **Sophie and Howl**, *Howl's Moving Castle* (film, 2004): his diamond-pattern jacket and blond hair, her blue dress and grey braid, a paper Calcifer flame. 4 hours; $50 DIY/$110 buy; wigs yes; read 3/5.
- **Chihiro and No-Face**, *Spirited Away* (film, 2001): her striped shirt and ponytail, a black hooded robe, a white mask with purple marks. 2.5 hours; $30 DIY/$70 buy; no wig; read 4/5.
- **San and Ashitaka**, *Princess Mononoke* (film, 1997): her white fur cape and red face marks, his indigo tunic, a bow. 5 hours; $60 DIY/$130 buy; no wig; read 3/5.
- **Kiki and Jiji**, *Kiki's Delivery Service* (film, 1989): her dark dress, big red bow and broom; all-black clothes with cat ears. 1 hour; $20 DIY/$60 buy; no wig; read 3/5.
- **Satsuki and Totoro**, *My Neighbor Totoro* (film, 1988): a grey Totoro onesie with a leaf on top, a summer dress, one black umbrella. 1 hour; $35 DIY/$60 buy; no wig; read 5/5.

### 5. Mismatched-height and gender-flexible pairs (5 pairs)

- **Taiga and Ryuji**, *Toradora!* (anime, 2008): a tiger motif for the small one, a dragon motif for the tall one, a foam practice sword. 2 hours; $35 DIY/$80 buy; Taiga's long wig; read 2/5.
- **Legoshi and Haru**, *Beastars* (anime, 2019): grey wolf ears and tail, white rabbit ears, matching school vests. 2.5 hours; $40 DIY/$80 buy; wigs optional; read 2/5.
- **Edward and Alphonse**, *Fullmetal Alchemist* (anime, 2003): red coat and blond braid, a silver glove, the taller partner in foam armour. 10 hours; $90 DIY/$200 buy; Ed's wig yes; read 2/5.
- **Ash and Pikachu**, *Pokémon* (anime, 1997): red-and-white cap, blue vest, a yellow onesie with red cheeks. 1 hour; $35 DIY/$70 buy; no wig; read 5/5.
- **Hinata and Kageyama**, *Haikyu!!* (anime, 2014): black-and-orange jerseys numbered 10 and 9, knee pads, a volleyball. 1.5 hours; $40 DIY/$90 buy; wigs optional; read 2/5.

## Which anime couple costume fits your time and budget?

The five groups, compared:

| Group | Build hours | Cost for two, DIY to buy | Pairs needing a wig | Average read |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beginner and closet | 1–2 | $15–$90 | 1 of 5 | 1.2 / 5 |
| Iconic classics | 3–6 | $45–$140 | 5 of 5 | 3.6 / 5 |
| Recent hits | 2–6 | $30–$150 | 5 of 6 | 1.5 / 5 |
| Studio Ghibli | 1–5 | $20–$130 | 1 of 5 | 3.6 / 5 |
| Mismatched and flexible | 1–10 | $35–$200 | 2 of 5 | 2.6 / 5 |

Ghibli matches the classics on readability with four fewer wigs; recent hits cost about the same but average 1.5.

## Wig care and coloured contacts: what to get right

Wigs carry most classic pairs. Detangle them from the tips upward with a wide-tooth comb, store them on a head form, and apply heat only if the label says heat-resistant.

Skip the coloured lenses that Hinata's pale eyes or Gojo's blue ones seem to call for. In an [American Academy of Ophthalmology answer from 26 September 2013](https://www.aao.org/eye-health/glasses-contacts/colored-contact-lenses), ophthalmologist Richard G. Shugarman writes that contact lenses should be fitted only by licensed professionals, that shops and flea markets selling unfitted lenses are usually breaking the law, and that "We see a lot of this around Halloween!"

## Cosplay is not consent: party and convention etiquette

A costume is not an invitation. [Naka-Kon's cosplay etiquette page](https://naka-kon.com/cosplay/etiquette), for an anime convention whose next edition runs 12–14 March 2027, rules out touching a cosplayer, their costume or props without permission, photos without asking, and lewd comments.

Being "in character" is no excuse for bothering anyone either. An [ABC News report from 11 April 2026](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-04-11/rules-of-cosplay-comic-con-supanova-conventions/106486754) found "cosplay is not consent" written at conventions across Australia, and quoted academic Emerald King on what happens to cosplayers' photos online, including deepfakes. At a house party, ask before photographing another couple, and before posting your own.

## How to send your anime couple photo after Halloween

The [Happy Halloween page](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) has a partner mode. You add a letter and up to six photos; they knock three times on a little haunted house, wipe fog off portraits to find your pictures, and answer "Will you be my boo?". You get an email the first time they answer.

It ends with a Boo License sized 1080×1920 for an Instagram Story, which suits the 48.3% who open shared pages on a phone. Each SubhSandesh page averages 11.1 views, and 38.5% of creators password-protect theirs before sharing, a sensible habit for costume photos. For more than six shots, the [premium Halloween page](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) takes up to 12 photos and a 60-second voice note.

## When an anime couple costume is the wrong call

If your partner has never watched anime, a 1/5 pair means explaining yourselves all night; pick a 4 or 5. If one of you hates wigs, the classics are out, because all 5 need at least one.

Our page has limits too. The Boo License costume picker offers ghost, witch, vampire, pumpkin, black cat, skeleton, mummy or bat, not anime characters, and the interface is English only. A printed photo still beats a link for a partner who wants it on the fridge.

## Sources

- Lamerichs, N., *Transformative Works and Cultures* 18, 15 March 2015.
- Archana, V. et al., *BMC Psychology*, 2026, via Europe PMC.
- American Academy of Ophthalmology, Ask an Ophthalmologist, 26 September 2013.
- Naka-Kon, Cosplay Etiquette (no publication date).
- Razak, I., ABC News, 11 April 2026.
